---
title: "10.2 - Labor Replacement"
---

#### 🧠 Think: 
- *What happens as automation replaces humans as the best way to produce economic value? How many human jobs with automation replace?*

#### 📖 Read: 
  - Frey and Osborne, 2017. "[The future of employment: How susceptible are jobs to computerisation?](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0040162516302244)"
  - Frey and Osborne, 2023. "[Generative Al and the Future of Work: A Reappraisal](https://heinonline.org/HOL/P?h=hein.journals/brownjwa30&i=161)"

#### 📺 Watch: 
- CGP Grey, "[Humans Need Not Apply](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7Pq-S557XQU)"

#### 🎧 Listen:
